watches.name: Atlas (World Labs)
watches.source_title: Atlas: A World Model for Spatial Intelligence
watches.summary: World Labs' next-generation omni world model, pretrained from scratch on text, images, video, and 3D. A multimodal autoregressive diffusion transformer with spatial context. Camera-controlled image/video generation (up to 1 minute at 1440p), spatial reconstruction from 1–dozens of images with explicit 3D (point clouds, 3D Gaussian splats), space-time simulation including video reframing and Real-to-Sim for robotics, plus text-to-image and 360 panoramas. Will power future versions of Marble and other World Labs products.
watches.pricing_note: Early access with select partners. Request access on the official blog. Not a public self-serve product; no published plan prices as of 2026-09-01.
